network_isolation_review.interpretation: The final eth0 transmit counts are consistent with forwarding the synthetic workload outside the veth pair; achieved rates and resource measurements include the effects of additional network work.
network_isolation_review.corrected_rerun: README.md now disables IPv4 forwarding at container creation and checks receiver forwarding before replay; neither published matrix has been rerun with that correction.

measurement_storage: Container overlay filesystem at /bench, not the macOS bind mount
background_services: OrbStack Kubernetes CoreDNS and local-path provisioner (plus their pause containers) were running; the desktop host was shared and not reserved for benchmarking.
primary_plan: Unmodified harness defaults: 100000,250000,500000,750000,1000000 pps, three repetitions each, five-second minimum, one-million-packet minimum.
supplemental_plan: 150000,200000,300000,400000,1000000 pps, three repetitions each, otherwise the same settings. Selected after the primary matrix showed sender-rate shortfalls above 250000 pps. Keeping 1000000 in the second matrix regenerates the identical five-million-packet trace. No original repetitions are discarded.
